questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Twelve identical resistors of resistance $R = 12\,\Omega$ in [Current Electricity] form the edges of a skeleton cube. What is the equivalent resistance between two body diagonally opposite corners of the cube?
questions.solution: By path symmetry, total current $I$ entering divides into three $I/3$ currents, then six $I/6$ currents, then three $I/3$ currents. Total potential difference is $V = \frac{I R}{3} + \frac{I R}{6} + \frac{I R}{3} = \frac{5}{6} I R \implies R_{eq} = \frac{5}{6} R = \frac{5}{6} \times (12) = 10\,\Omega$.
questions.explanation: Analyze the physical model and equations in Current Electricity.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A potentiometer wire of length $L = 10\text{ m}$ and resistance $R = 20\,\Omega$ is connected in series with an accumulator of EMF $E = 4\text{ V}$ and internal resistance $0$. What is the potential gradient along the wire in $\text{V/m}$ multiplied by $10$?
questions.solution: Potential gradient is $k_g = \frac{E}{L} = \frac{4}{10} = 0.4\text{ V/m}$. Multiplied by 10, the integer value is $4$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Current Electricity.
